data.title: Bitcoin ETFs rakes in the dough
data.description: In this episode of the Daily Wolf, Scott Melker discusses Mastercard (MA) and SoFi's (SOFI) new stablecoin partnership, Binance investing $100 million into Circle's (CRCL) global USDC expansion, and a strong two-day run for bitcoin (BTC-USD) ETFs which raked in $1.7 billion in inflows.
